answer: Velvet Rope Queueing: each identity joins a service queue whose position advances only by uninterrupted presence. A gap collapses the slot; rejoining means waiting behind the existing reef of accumulated dwell time. An anchor token marks the slot's age and cannot transfer. To run N sybils, an attacker must staff N parallel queues continuously, paying N× the opportunity cost of sustained attention—foregone parallel work and idle capital—while any pause resets that identity's seniority.
